why_this_posture: Current hardware, packaging, and subsystem pressure already look mismatched to a discreet consumer-tier wearable cost story. Wireless and firmware gaps still add likely hidden cost pressure. Declared intent remains `functional_prototype` / `exploratory`, so prototype value and product viability should not be conflated.
major_cost_risk_factors: A discreet consumer-wearable posture pushes miniaturization, packaging, and industrial-design pressure before cost credibility is proven.
Current component posture is only subsystem-BOM-level, which is enough to see packaging pressure but not enough to support a consumer-tier cost story.
Wireless posture is still `needs_attention` / `limited_evidence`, so radio, battery, and reconnect behavior still carry economic risk.
Firmware posture is still `needs_attention` / `limited_evidence`, so touch-input and display-control simplicity may cost more than the prototype framing suggests.
Trust, privacy, and capture-visible behavior may force more expensive implementation choices than a pure prototype sketch would imply.
cost_unknowns: No final BOM, grounded component shortlist, or procurement-grade package exists yet, so exact cost would be fake precision.
Battery, thermal, and weight tradeoffs inside a discreet frame are not grounded enough yet to support a credible end-cost posture.
Phone-first boundary, radio dependency, and display architecture are still too open to treat final system cost as knowable.
Current implementation-package posture is reviewable, but it is still far below a final build package or product-grade cost basis.
what_would_improve_cost_confidence: Decide explicitly whether the target is prototype learning or a cost-sensitive consumer product tier.
Capture concrete link-latency or reconnect evidence from the phone-first path before reopening boundary changes.
Ground firmware readiness in explicit touch-input and display-control behavior instead of inferring it from project intent.
No grounded component-shortlist, schematic-direction, interface-map, or subsystem-breakdown artifact currently justifies a stronger BOM package.

no provisional implementation package draft is currently emitted; Implementation-package review can stay live for prototype buildability, but current cost posture `product_tier_mismatch_risk` block...
prototype_only_vs_product_viable_view: As a prototype-learning path this can still be worthwhile, but for a discreet consumer product target the current direction is economically weak enough that it should be stopped or reframed unless cost posture improves.
operator_cost_warning: Do not assume this becomes a real product just because the prototype direction is interesting. Current cost posture is weak enough that commercial ambition should pause, stop, or reframe unless cost-sensitive assumptions improve.

trust_posture.authority_scope: cost viability and economic posture judgment
trust_posture.trust_reason: Use this surface to judge whether the current project direction still makes economic sense as more than a prototype path. It is directional and conservative, not a fake BOM calculator.
